```json
 "topology": "Current-mode PMOS-pass LDO: PMOS-input 5T OTA with lag-lead (Rz-Cz) output, NMOS CS gate driver into a PMOS diode that is mirrored K:1 by the pass device, output-cap-dominant loop, Cff across R1",
 "rationale": "The pass gate is a low-impedance node (1/gm of a diode, scaled K), so the loop can be output-cap dominant with tens of MHz UGB. That bandwidth is needed because a 10 mA/100 ns step on 1 nF forces sub-100 mV undershoot. Rz sets the high-frequency gain for phase margin. Cz restores ~60x DC gain for load and line regulation. The gate tracks vin, which gives PSRR. Iq budget: IREF 10 + bias 5 + tail 40 + divider 5 + 2*10.5 driver = ~81 uA."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "K":      (10, 5, 40),          # pass : diode mirror ratio
    "gmid_p": (8, 5, 14),           # pass-device gm/Id at max load
    "Lp":     (0.18, 0.15, 0.4),    # pass / mirror-diode L
    "Itail":  (40e-6, 20e-6, 60e-6),# OTA tail current
    "Ahf":    (3.0, 1.5, 8.0),      # high-frequency OTA gain gm1*Rz
    "fz":     (300e3, 80e3, 1e6),   # lag-lead zero frequency 1/(2pi Rz Cz)
    "Cff":    (5e-12, 1e-12, 20e-12),# feed-forward cap across R1
    "gmid5":  (10, 6, 16),          # gate-driver NMOS gm/Id at max current
    "Rdiv":   (240e3, 100e3, 600e3),# total divider resistance
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec["vref"]; iref = spec["iref"]; vt = spec["vout_target"]
    imax = spec["iload_max"]; imin = spec["iload_min"]; cl = spec["cl"]
    K = int(round(p["K"]))

    # ---- feedback divider ----
    Rt = p["Rdiv"]; R2 = Rt * vref / vt; R1 = Rt - R2
    idiv = vt / Rt

    # ---- pass device + mirror diode (gate node is low-impedance) ----
    ipm = 1.2 * (imax + idiv)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], ipm, vds=0.6)
    W6 = max(mp.W / K, 0.42)

    # ---- gate driver NMOS (CS, drain = pass gate) ----
    i5h = ipm / K
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], 0.15, i5h, vds=0.7)

    # ---- error amp: PMOS-input 5T OTA ----
    it = p["Itail"]
    m1 = lut.size("p", 15, 0.5, it / 2, vds=0.8)
    m3 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, it / 2, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, it, vds=0.35)

    # ---- bias chain: ibias diode -> nmos mirror -> pmos diode -> tail ----
    ipb = 5e-6
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, ipb, vds=0.9)
    mb2 = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, ipb, vds=0.9)

    # ---- lag-lead network at OTA output ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    Rz = p["Ahf"] / gm1
    Cz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * p["fz"])

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MB2", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mb2)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "pb", "vin", "vin", mt)
    # OTA (M2 on feedback side -> output x)
    n.dev("M1", "nd1", "vref", "tail", "tail", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "fb", "tail", "tail", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd1", "nd1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "nd1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CZ", "nz", "vss", Cz)
    # gate driver + K:1 mirror into pass
    n.dev("M5", "g", "x", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.M("M6", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", W6, p["Lp"])
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp)
    # divider + feed-forward
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("CFF", "vout", "fb", p["Cff"])

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    Ro = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    Adc = gm1 * Ro
    beta = R2 / (R1 + R2)
    ih = imax + idiv
    il = imin + idiv
    gm5h = m5.gm * ih / ipm
    gm5l = 25.0 * il / K                     # weak inversion at light load
    Ghf_h = p["Ahf"] * gm5h * K              # beta_hf ~ 1 thanks to Cff
    Gdc_h = Adc * beta * gm5h * K
    dVx = math.log(ih / il) / 22.0 + 0.04    # driver Vgs change over load range
    load_reg = dVx / (Adc * beta) / (imax - imin)
    gdsp = mp.gds * ih / ipm
    line_reg = (gdsp + K * m5.gds) / Gdc_h
    psrr = -20 * math.log10(max(line_reg, 1e-6))
    iq = iref + ipb + it + idiv + 2 * il / K
    undershoot = 0.2 / (p["Ahf"] + 0.5) + 0.5 * imax / Ghf_h
    overshoot = K * mp.cgg * (1 + 1.0 / K) * 0.35 / cl + 0.02
    vout_err = 100 * (0.25 / Adc) * 2 / vt * 1.0
    ugb_h = Ghf_h / (2 * PI * cl)
    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "overshoot": overshoot,
        "ripple_settled": 2e-3,
        "ugb_heavy_hz": ugb_h,
    }
```
